description: Contact details a company publishes on its own website, from its domain or any URL of the site: shared emails only (contact@, press@, dpo@; personal addresses are never returned, only counted), phone numbers in E.164 with type (switchboard, customer service, fax), head-office address, company social pages (LinkedIn, X, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, GitHub), contact form URL, and legal identifiers checked (SIREN Luhn, VAT checksum, RCS, Impressum register, legal form, share capital) and matched to the French registry (official_name, siren_match). Every field carries the page it was read on. robots.txt honoured. 0.005 USDC per call, charged only if something is found.

url.description: Any URL of the company site (alternative to domain)

name: company_contacts
